from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u072/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = 6
    seen = set()
    q = deque()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r in (0, h - 1) or c in (0, w - 1)) and grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in seen:
                seen.add((r, c))
                q.append((r, c))
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg and (nr, nc) not in seen:
                seen.add((nr, nc))
                q.append((nr, nc))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in seen:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
